newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Sabesp still a Flemings buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Sabesp still a Flemings buy.

text.p: Robert Flemings said in a report it had reiterated its buy rating on Sao Paulo state sewage company Sabesp.
-- It also said it had increased its 1998 earnings forecasts for the company to 703.8 million reais from 615 million reais.
-- It said Sabesp's debut on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) "should be accompanied by huge trading volumes and continued outperformance."
-- Sabesp began trade on the Sao Paulo bolsa Wednesday. It closed at 290.01 reais in volume of 7.3 million reais.
-- Flemings said, "Sabesp technically has the potential to reduce its workforce by 7,000 employees yielding savings of 375 million reais based on the average 1996 salary of 53,600 reais."

-- Based on meetings with Sabesp officials, Flemings said there are several factors that could help Sabesp's stock "continue its spectacular run." These include new concessions and a strategic partner.

-- At a news conference Wednesday on Sabesp's listing, President Ariovaldo Carmignani said the company is studying the possibility of a strategic partner. He said, however, that an eventual sale of stock to such a partner would take place only next year.
-- Sabesp voting stock was up 2.07 percent at 296 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bourse.
